name: 30247-longprefill-longcatlite-tp2
model: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite-FP8, the source's own checkpoint at its own size. 69.1B parameters, ~102 GB over 26 shards. Public and ungated, but not in the local HF cache.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:2), one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. Two cards is a sizing decision: ~94.8 GiB of weights does not fit an 80 GB card.
architecture: LongcatFlashForCausalLM, block-wise fp8 (weight_block_size 128x128). 14 layers, hidden 3072, 256 routed + 128 zero experts at moe_topk 12, MLA (kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64), YaRN rope over 327680 positions, n-gram over-embedding table in front of the decoder.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 1800 s safety cap; ~1536 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix and no prefix bucket. Prompts average 8192 tokens (stdev 1536, clamped to [5120, 11264]), generations 128 (stdev 32, clamped to [64, 256]), `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-document analysis service on two GPUs, handling 16 concurrent 8000-token prompts with short answers.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested blocks, and a dropped block means the
# engine runs without something this file declares.

model-path: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite-FP8

tp-size: 2

# REQUIRED FOR THIS CHECKPOINT TO BE SERVED AT ALL. The published config.json declares
# `architectures: ["LongcatFlashNgramForCausalLM"]`, a name this engine's model registry does
# not carry, so without the rename it falls back to `TransformersForCausalLM` and serves the
# checkpoint through a generic path. There is no flag for this.
json-model-override-args: {"architectures": ["LongcatFlashForCausalLM"]}

max-running-requests: 64

# Prompts are independently sampled and share no real prefix, so radix caching has nothing to
# reuse; off, every request is served the same way.
disable-radix-cache: true
